assessment.reason: Recent volume, career baseline and a weak opposing pass defense all point over 31.5 at the best available price. The defense adjustment inflates the size of the edge.
assessment.model_case: Jones's attempts ran 31, 31, 36, 34, 44, 42 and 22, clearing 31.5 in four of seven. The pre-adjustment mean of 33.5 already sits above the line. The defense stage then adds nearly four attempts based on yards allowed, which is weaker evidence for attempt volume. That stage pushes the raw estimate well above the calibrated one.
assessment.price_case: This is the main line at every book. -104 is the cheapest over; other books range from -105 to -125, implying the market also leans over. If the true mean were near 31.5, the price would be slightly negative, so value relies on the underlying volume holding.
assessment.context_case: Reported trade talks involve Jonathan Taylor. If he were dealt before kickoff, the run game could thin and passing volume could rise. Nothing supplied says a deal occurred. The 22-attempt game is unexplained.

qualitative_review.countercase: The defense adjustment may overstate volume, since a defense that allows yards can still face fewer attempts if Indianapolis leads and runs. The 22-attempt outing shows a low-volume script is possible. Taylor staying and carrying a normal load keeps the run share intact.

Identify why Week 7 produced only 22 attempts, such as a blowout or an early exit.

assessment.reason: Recent volume, career baseline and a weak opposing pass defense all point over 31.5 at the best available price. The defense adjustment inflates the size of the edge.
assessment.model_case: Jones's attempts ran 31, 31, 36, 34, 44, 42 and 22, clearing 31.5 in four of seven. The pre-adjustment mean of 33.5 already sits above the line. The defense stage then adds nearly four attempts based on yards allowed, which is weaker evidence for attempt volume. That stage pushes the raw estimate well above the calibrated one.
assessment.price_case: This is the main line at every book. -104 is the cheapest over; other books range from -105 to -125, implying the market also leans over. If the true mean were near 31.5, the price would be slightly negative, so value relies on the underlying volume holding.
assessment.context_case: Reported trade talks involve Jonathan Taylor. If he were dealt before kickoff, the run game could thin and passing volume could rise. Nothing supplied says a deal occurred. The 22-attempt game is unexplained.

qualitative_review.countercase: The defense adjustment may overstate volume, since a defense that allows yards can still face fewer attempts if Indianapolis leads and runs. The 22-attempt outing shows a low-volume script is possible. Taylor staying and carrying a normal load keeps the run share intact.
open_checks: Check whether any Taylor trade was completed before the 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff.
Identify why Week 7 produced only 22 attempts, such as a blowout or an early exit.
Reconfirm the -104 price at DraftKings.
